title: UAPI: wire.h stub may silently diverge from kernel uapi if CRYPTO2DEV_HAVE_UAPI_HEADER not set
description: The compile-time static_assert guards in crypto2dev_wire.h verify that local stub struct sizes match expected values (240, 36, 260, 20, 656, 656, 856, 112, 104, 472). These guards protect against size drift between the stub and kernel uapi. However: (1) field-order changes within a struct preserve total size but produce wrong ioctl semantics with no compile-time error; (2) the expected-size constants in the static_assert are hardcoded in the stub — if the kernel uapi changes both the struct AND the size, both the stub and the guard must be updated manually. Consequence: any build that does not set CRYPTO2DEV_HAVE_UAPI_HEADER (i.e., builds without access to the kernel tree) cannot detect field-order divergence. Mitigation: document that CRYPTO2DEV_HAVE_UAPI_HEADER must be set in production builds, and add a comment explaining what field-order changes the static_assert cannot catch.
